text:
alex_chang: Seeing sustained queue depth on apac-gpu-pool, avg token latency up ~40ms for 10m. Errors are low but pod CPU is pegged. Proposing a targeted 15% shift from APAC -> NA-West for models with small KV usage.

maya_k: Can we avoid cache cold-starts? Which buckets are safe to move?

alex_chang: Good call — only move requests routed to model:v2-small and v2-quant. Those have compatible KV format and warm caches in NA. Avoid v3/long-context.

liam_ops: Ready to run a precision weight swap. Plan: 15% over 10m in 3 steps (5/5/5) with health checks on latency and queue depth. If errors or 10% latency regression -> rollback.

liam_ops: Command (GSLB control plane):
```bash
# step 1: 5%
curl -X POST https://gslb.internal/api/weights 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
  -d '{"region":"na-west","model_groups":["v2-small","v2-quant"],"weight_delta":5}'
```

maya_k: Add a short-circuit in the routing policy to avoid long-tail networks from APAC to NA for audio workloads. Also tag the change with incident id.

alex_chang: Doing that. Incident id inc-2026-0421. Liam, please add tag and set canary timeout to 3m.

liam_ops: Tag added, starting step 1 now. Monitoring: dashboard link -> https://dash.board/reds/incident/inc-2026-0421 (logs, p50/p95, queue depth).

deploy-bot: weight-change job queued by liam_ops (id: job-8342). ETA 30s. :gear:

liam_ops: Step 1 applied. APAC->NA weight delta +5 for v2-small/v2-quant. Latency p95 changed +8ms so far, queue depth down 12%.

maya_k: Good. Keep an eye on cache-miss rate for that group. If miss rate >20% revert.

alex_chang: Step 2 in 3m if stable. Also aware of cost bump — estimate ~3% extra egress cost if this holds. Noted for billing.

liam_ops: Step 2 applied (+5 more). p95 holding +10ms, queue depth down 28%, error rate unchanged.

liam_ops: Final step applied (+5). Now total 15% shifted. p95 net +12ms, apac pod CPU down ~22%, queue backlog normalized.

sophia_sre: Observability: traces show tail offload to NA for short requests only. No increase in 5xx. Perf tests show throughput recovered.

maya_k: Confirming cache-miss is 9% for v2-small, OK. Marking canary success.

alex_chang: Leaving the 15% permanent for next 6h while we autoscale apac pool. Will revert if autoscaler catches up.

liam_ops: Documenting change in runbook and incident channel. Cost note: project infra-team saw +$420 egress estimate for 24h at current load.

deploy-bot: job-8342 completed successfully. :white_check_mark:

alex_chang: Thanks all — closing as "mitigated - surgical shift". If anything regresses, @sophia_sre escalate to full-region failover plan. :thumbsup:
